purpose: Prepare a machine-readable, target-blind request for affirmative candidate-local evidence of activation or nonactivation on the frozen event date, without sending any message and without changing the frozen candidate pool or matching.

event_scope.request_scope: Records sufficient to affirm activation, affirm nonactivation, or explicitly state that the institution cannot determine the status for the candidate polygon on the event date.

eligible_evidence_holders: Municipalidad Distrital de Lurigancho-Chosica or predecessor competent authority
requested_evidence_classes: event-day or immediate post-event georeferenced imagery
technical report with explicit spatial coverage
official geospatial inventory declared complete for the relevant corridor/event window

response_schema.source_reference: document/log/image/inventory identifier required for affirmative answers
response_schema.spatial_scope_statement: required; must explicitly cover the candidate polygon or contain an unambiguous geometry intersecting it
response_schema.event_scope_statement: required; must explicitly concern 2015-03-23 or a defined interval that includes it
response_schema.attachment_sha256: required if an attachment is supplied

forbidden: include target names or target outcomes
send email or external message from this workflow
